title: bromus rubens var. maximus
intro: Bromus rubens var. maximus, commonly known as Brome Grass, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the Poaceae family. The plant is valued for its health benefits, which include its potential to lower cholesterol levels and regulate blood sugar levels due to its prebiotic properties. The therapeutic actions of Brome Grass include its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Bromus rubens var. maximus include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other secondary metabolites that contribute to its medicinal properties.
